description: reddit-loop/loop.sh (the automated per-wake health/measurement function) never references posts.jsonl at all -- it only reads comment_karma_total from the account ledger and attributed_lm_signups. Unlike capafy, which has an explicit '6-week-death guard' asserting the publish pipeline actually ran within 2 days (loop.sh:45), reddit-loop has NO equivalent freshness guard verifying that a real post/comment has actually been made recently.

evidence.snippet:
HEAL=""; add_heal(){ HEAL="$HEAL$1; "; }
# HEAL: is there at least one reddit account provisioned?
... [ "$N_ACCT" -ge 1 ] ... add_heal "NO-REDDIT-ACCOUNT ..."
# HEAL: CloakBrowser daily-driver reachable ...
... KARMA=... SIGNUPS=... (no reference to posts.jsonl anywhere in this file)

concreteFailureScenario: The model repeatedly decides STEP2 is a no-op ('no self-promo-welcome sub found today') for weeks. reddit-loop/loop.sh keeps reporting STATUS="ACT — post ONE ..." forever; no HEAL is ever triggered and no restart is ever forced by the automated health function, because nothing in it checks whether an actual post has happened recently -- only a human manually running verify-loops.sh would ever notice.
